correctionNotes: No exact AutoEq/Crinacle correction was found for Moondrop Old Fashioned, so do not claim a true measured Crinacle EQ; use conservative Crinacle/IEF-neutral-style shaping.

Official/vendor pages describe it as 40mm on-ear/open-back; user requested open over-ear handling, so use open-back headphone assumptions: avoid aggressive sub-bass forcing and preserve open-stage mids.
RAA has a measurement report for this model, but this profile/preset is not derived from raw exported Crinacle measurements.
Preserve the clear midrange and vocal presentation; this is the model's main strength.
Add modest low-end/body support only; seal and pad pressure strongly affect bass response.
Smooth likely rough regions with small cuts around 3-3.5 kHz and 5-6 kHz rather than changing the whole tonal balance.
signature: Retro open-back portable headphone; user wants it treated as open over-ear/open-back in the library. Light body and seal-dependent bass, clear forward mids/vocals, open stereo feel, smooth but not highly extended treble, with possible roughness around upper-mids/lower-treble.
